text:
Midweek, the gate team read your second message with care and saw that you were upset about the handling of your companion animal travel arrangements and the lack of a clear response from Aurelia Skyways. We understand the concern. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is meant to keep communication steady, respectful, and useful, and we did not meet that standard in your case.

We have reviewed the file and the note trail from the gate desk, the service desk, and the animal handling team. The issue was not the safety of your pet, but the way the situation was explained and passed along. That should have been handled more clearly, and we regret the confusion it caused at the airport. When a traveler is already managing carrier checks, document review, and the stress of boarding with an animal, the desk must stay direct and responsive. That did not happen here.

Your complaint has been shared with the station lead and the companion animal coordinator so the gaps can be corrected. We are also reminding staff to send a plain update when a pet case changes, even if the answer is only that the matter is still under review. Brief does not mean abrupt, and careful does not mean slow. It means the traveler gets a clear statement without having to press for it again.

If you still need help with the trip record, a service correction, or follow-up on the handling note, reply through the same channel and we will keep the thread active. We will not ask you to repeat details already on file unless something must be confirmed for accuracy. The goal is to settle the issue, restore trust, and make the next step easier for both you and your companion animal.

We appreciate the chance to address this and we will keep the matter moving with proper attention. Companion Animal Travel Desk
